speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked	the Minister for Health (a) how many CHAS blue card holders have used up the maximum amount of subsidies they are entitled to in the past three years; and (b) whether the Ministry will increase the $480 annual cap on CHAS subsidies for chronic conditions.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Just now, the Minister of State mentioned that the amount per MediSave account, including their children's accounts, and for those cases where their children do not have money to support them, is there any other way that we can seek help for our residents?

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: We will look at each case and see how best we can help.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: We will see, for each case, how best to assist them.
